listing.name: Crash Team Racing (CTR Recompiled)
listing.summary: An experimental Crash Team Racing port with critical post-race and ChangeLevel failures reported by the project. Windows, Linux and macOS setup packages use Generate & Build; exact host CPU architectures are unconfirmed. Use your own USA PlayStation SCUS-94426 CUE/BIN. The current game.toml requires data track 1 to be 605,698,800 bytes with SHA-1 1bb785082def3fe25f6b46be06d4eaf33c5bc772 and boot executable SCUS_944.26. Setup uses OpenBIOS unless you supply your own local SCPH BIOS. Original images and proprietary BIOS are not distributed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
